en.headline: Sources say Tai Po fire report names four government bodies for accountability
en.dek: The independent committee’s report, submitted on Thursday, is understood to highlight the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit among others, without naming individual officials.
body: Sources familiar with the independent committee’s report on the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po said the document, submitted to Chief Executive John Lee on Thursday, names four government bodies for dereliction of duty.

According to the sources, the Housing Bureau’s Independent Checking Unit bears the greatest responsibility among the four, which also include the Buildings Department, the Fire Services Department and the Labour Department. The report does not name any individual officials.

The sources added that specific accountability measures would be left to the government. Chief Executive John Lee has said the administration will study the report carefully and announce reform plans and accountability arrangements in due course.

zh.headline: 消息指大埔火災報告點名四個政府部門須負責
zh.dek: 獨立委員會周四提交的報告據悉點名房屋局獨立審查組等四個部門失職，但沒有點名個別官員。
body: 熟悉獨立委員會報告的消息人士表示，周四提交特首李家超的大埔宏福苑火災報告點名四個政府部門失職。
消息指，房屋局獨立審查組責任最大，其餘包括屋宇署、消防處及勞工處。報告沒有點名任何個別官員。
消息補充，具體問責安排交由政府決定。特首李家超表示政府會仔細研究報告，並在短期內公布改革計劃及追究責任安排。
